hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ti=d.get('tool_input',{}); print(ti.get('file_path',ti.get('notebook_path','')))" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] && case "$FILE" in *.py) python -m py_compile "$FILE" && echo "Python syntax OK: $FILE";; esac
